high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram Explore page, showcasing a sponsored post by the brand "zeppelin.official." The post features a close-up photograph of a wristwatch with a green dial and a black leather strap. The watch has a classic design with Roman numerals for the hour markers and a small date window at the 3 o'clock position. The watch is displayed on a textured surface that appears to be a combination of a light-colored fabric and a dark stone or concrete material. The overall aesthetic of the image is sleek and sophisticated, emphasizing the elegance of the watch.
